tests : take the test-fusion moe flag from the fixture name (#33104)

* tests : take the test-fusion moe flag from the fixture name

The moe flag came from the arch name, so the dense and MoE fixtures
of an arch shared a baseline key, and MoE-only archs were keyed as
dense. Read it from the -dense/-moe suffix written by
test-llama-archs and regenerate the Metal baseline. Only the moe
column changes, no count moves.

* Apply suggestion from ggerganov

items.body:
<details open>

CUDA: move the fusion code out of ggml-cuda.cu (#33087)

Move the fusion matchers, ggml_cuda_can_fuse, ggml_cuda_try_fuse and the
fusion alloc deps of graph_optimize into fusion.cu, unchanged.
fusion.cuh exports ggml_cuda_try_fuse and ggml_cuda_fusion_add_alloc_deps.
The GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_FUSION check is done by the two callers, and
ggml_cuda_is_view_or_noop moves to common.cuh since the compute loop
also uses it.

</details>
